responsibility: Declares the parameter-adjustment data structures and body-rewrite interfaces used when IPA passes change function prototypes. It defines adjustment records, parameter-prefix enums, the lightweight ipa_param_adjustments call-signature description, and the heavier ipa_param_body_adjustments class that rewrites PARM_DECLs, SSA uses, calls, debug info, and initialization statements. It is the common contract for clone materialization and IPA-SRA-style signature transformations.
same_name_distinction: Declares the parameter-adjustment model and body-rewrite interfaces—adjustment enums/records, lightweight call-signature descriptions, and the ipa_param_body_adjustments API used by clone materialization and IPA-SRA. Unlike gcc/ipa-param-manipulation.cc, it defines the contract and data structures, not the rewriting implementation.
